Page 4
This is the second and final part of a two-part episode. It will
begin with a recap of the preceding story, in which Agent Mulder
begs onto what appears a simple kidnapping-murder case -- a la
JonBenet Ramsey -- but turns out to be a disappearance closely
BED resembling that of his sister. During his unorthodox
investigation, Mulder's mother dies unexpectedly, but not before
contacting him in a mysterious phone call. Mulder comes to
believe his mother's death and the murder case are connected to
his missing sister. Emotionally vulnerable, he allows himself to
be convinced by a female convict that supernatural forces are at
work. But by episode's end, he has seemingly come to his senses
and discounted her paranormal explanation. Without saying so, he
believes his sister must be dead, and in the subsequent chase
and capture of a red-handed child killer he finds himself
standing in a field where there are multiple graves... which
might very well be Samantha's final resting place. GO TO BLACK.
MULDER (V.O., OVER BLACK)
They said the birds refused to
sing and the thermometer fell
suddenly, as if God himself had
his breath stolen away.
